title: Internal: Checking Account Closures - Accounts Receiving Direct Deposits
content:
## Recent Direct Deposits

- Payroll and benefit deposits that arrive at a closed account are returned to the sender and can take several weeks to be reissued.
- Do not close a personal checking account that has received a direct deposit within the last 30 days, even when the balance is $0.00 and every other closure requirement is met.

## Procedure

1. Review the account's recent transactions with get_bank_account_transactions_9173 before closing.
2. If a direct deposit posted within the last 30 days, do not process the closure. Transfer the customer to a human agent with reason 'account_closure_request' so the closure can be scheduled once the deposit has been redirected.
3. Otherwise, continue with the standard closure procedure.
